target.title: feat: inspect and set chat backgrounds
target.body:
## Summary
- add `imsg chat-background status` to inspect native macOS 26 transcript-background state from the local Messages DB
- support `imsg chat-background clear` / RPC `chats.removeBackground` through the native chat-background selector
- support `imsg chat-background set` / RPC `chats.setBackground` when the input is a valid PosterKit transcript background package with a sibling `-watchBackground` file
- stage background packages under Messages' container `tmp` directory before calling `setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:`
- advertise `chats.setBackground` in `rpc_methods` again now that the bridge path is live-tested

## Current Feature State
Supported in this PR:
- `imsg chat-background status --chat ... --json`
- `imsg chat-background clear --chat ... --json`
- `imsg chat-background set --chat ... --file /path/to/package`
- RPC `chats.removeBackground`
- RPC `chats.setBackground`

Input requirement for `set`:
- `--file` must point to a native PosterKit transcript background package.
- A sibling file at `<file>-watchBackground` must exist.
- This does not synthesize arbitrary image files into PosterKit packages.

## Redacted Proof
Proof target was the Lobster test group, redacted here as `any;+;[group-guid]`.

Important launch detail learned during proof: `imsg launch` without `--dylib` mapped the installed Homebrew helper at `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/imsg/0.12.3/...`, which returned `Unknown action: set-chat-background`. Relaunching with the repo-built helper fixed that:
```text
$ ./bin/imsg launch --dylib /Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib --json
{"message":"Messages.app launched with dylib injection","dylib":"/Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib","status":"launched"}

$ vmmap [Messages pid] | rg 'imsg-bridge-helper'
/Users/lobster/GitHub/imsg/bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib
```

Bridge readiness after relaunch:
```json
{"v2_ready":true,"selectors":{"chatBackground":true},"rpc_methods":["chats.setBackground","chats.removeBackground"]}
```

Clear proof from the bridge path:
```json
{"selector":"setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:","chatGuid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_cleared":true}
```

Status after clear:
```json
{"chat_id":22,"chat_guid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_set":false,"background_channel_guid":null,"cache_exists":false,"watch_background_exists":false,"latest_event":{"row_id":6803,"guid":"99F93E69-4D3B-43C7-9D57-6B49AEDE2443","date":"2026-07-09T19:20:24Z","action":"clear"}}
```

Set proof using a staged copy of an existing native PosterKit package:
```json
{"chatGuid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_set":true,"backgroundGuid":"6F235A9F-0787-4724-BCE7-712887BE10D1","selector":"setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:","backgroundURL":"file:///Users/lobster/Library/Containers/com.apple.MobileSMS/Data/tmp/imsg-chat-background/[redacted]/[redacted]"}
```

Status after set:
```json
{"chat_id":22,"chat_guid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_set":true,"background_channel_guid":"6F235A9F-0787-4724-BCE7-712887BE10D1","cache_exists":true,"watch_background_exists":true,"poster_version":1,"file_size":855710,"latest_event":{"row_id":6804,"guid":"6F235A9F-0787-4724-BCE7-712887BE10D1","date":"2026-07-09T19:20:27Z","action":"set"}}
```

DB event proof:
```text
6804|6F235A9F-0787-4724-BCE7-712887BE10D1|4|2026-07-09 19:20:27
6803|99F93E69-4D3B-43C7-9D57-6B49AEDE2443|6|2026-07-09 19:20:24
```

## Verification
- head: `1576352`
- `swift build` ✅
- `make build` ✅ (existing warnings only: SQLite module-cache rebuild note, deprecated `NSKeyedUnarchiver unarchiveObjectWithData:`)
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `make lint` ❌ local SwiftLint runtime crash after format lint passes: `SourceKittenFramework/library_wrapper.swift:58: Fatal error: Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ❌ local toolchain blocked before tests execute: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`

## Notes
- This remains macOS 26-gated and fail-closed.
- Status output intentionally omits/redacts sensitive PosterKit transfer key/signature fields from `chat.properties`.
